author: Your Name
project_description: This is a template repository for Python projects that use uv for their dependency management.

__prompts__.author_github_handle: Your GitHub username (the 'username' part of github.com/username)

layout.flat: Flat - simpler, code in project root (recommended for small projects)
layout.src: src/ - code in src/ folder (recommended for published packages)

minimum_python_version.__prompt__: Minimum Python version (lower = more compatible, higher = newer features)

development_python_version.__prompt__: Development Python version (.python-version, Docker and devcontainer images; must be >= the minimum)

type_checker.__prompt__: Type checker (catches bugs by analyzing type hints)
type_checker.pyright: Pyright - fast, strict, great IDE support (recommended)
type_checker.ty: ty - experimental, extremely fast (by Astral/Ruff team)
type_checker.mypy: mypy - mature, widely used, more lenient
type_checker.pyrefly: Pyrefly - fast, stable 1.0 checker by Meta, easy migration from mypy

__prompts__.include_py_typed: Mark package as typed? (Yes if others will import your code)
__prompts__.include_github_actions: Set up GitHub Actions? (Auto-runs tests and checks on every push)
__prompts__.codecov: Track test coverage with Codecov? (Shows which code lines your tests cover)
__prompts__.publish_to_pypi: Set up PyPI publishing? (Yes if you want 'pip install your-package' to work)
__prompts__.deptry: Check for unused/missing dependencies with deptry?
__prompts__.dockerfile: Include Dockerfile? (For deploying to cloud services or sharing a reproducible environment)
__prompts__.devcontainer: Include devcontainer config? (For GitHub Codespaces or VS Code with all tools pre-installed)
__prompts__.mkdocs: Include MkDocs? (Generate documentation website from markdown)
__prompts__.dvc: Include DVC? (Track large data files and ML experiments that Git shouldn't handle)
__prompts__.changelog: Include a CHANGELOG.md? (Keep a Changelog format, for tracking notable changes per release)

agent_instructions.codex: Codex only - AGENTS.md for OpenAI Codex
agent_instructions.claude: Claude only - CLAUDE.md for Anthropic Claude
agent_instructions.all: All - include all AI assistant files

agent_profile.minimal: Minimal - quick reference, essential commands only
